slides.title: What’s Next?
text: Researchers generally agree that, models exploit all
the structures in PDB and we need more data.
• Thermodynamics (e.g., folding ratio) and kinetics (e.g., folding rate)?
• Additional modalities, like DNAs, RNAs, ligands, and so on…
